# Overview

We here use data from Endicott et al., Nature Communications 2022, Cell division drives DNA methylation loss in late-replicating domains in primary human cells.
We use input files for "EPIC probes for Solo-WCGW CpGs in common PMDs" and "EPIC probes for Solo-WCGW CpGs in common HMDs".

```{r}
pmd <- fread("../../../../Data/ExtData/soloWCGW/EPIC.comPMD.probes.tsv.gz")$V4
hmd <- fread("../../../../Data/ExtData/soloWCGW/EPIC.comHMD.probes.tsv.gz")$V4
```


# IM DM results

See DGE_Result_Overview.html for definitions of hyper/hypomethylated CpG cutoff values.


```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists.Rdata"))
```

## Hyper-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hyper_cpg, nrow)
```

## Hypo-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hypo_cpg, nrow)
```

# IM vs. Non-IM, only new (EPIC) samples 

```{r}
comp = "IM_vs_nonIM"
```

```{r}
dm_im <- rbind(all_hyper_cpg[[comp]], all_hypo_cpg[[comp]])
dm_im$direction_im <- ifelse(dm_im$logFC > 0, "hyper","hypo")
dm_im$dge_class <- with(dm_im, ifelse(logFC > 0, ifelse(logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(logFC< -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))

dm_im$pmd_class = ifelse(dm_im$Row.names %in% pmd, "PMD", ifelse(dm_im$Row.names %in% hmd, "HMD","other"))
im_vs_healthy_results <- dm_im
```

```{r}
table(im_vs_healthy_results$pmd_class)
m <- table(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class, im_vs_healthy_results$pmd_class, dnn=c("DGE class","PMD class"))
m
m |> prop.table(margin=1) |> round(digits = 3)
```
